title: Restaurant SEO: Boosting Restaurant Rankings on Google Now

facts.fact: The page cites Mordor Intelligence as projecting the Malaysia foodservice market to grow at a CAGR of 12.89% over the 2023-2029 period.
The page states, without naming a source, that the top Google search result gets about 33% of all clicks.
facts.quote: Being the top result on Google, it gets about 33% of all the clicks, so it's a big deal.

facts.fact: The page states, without naming a source, that more than half of visitors to restaurant websites arrive through organic search.
facts.quote: more than half of the people who visit their restaurant websites do so through organic search

facts.fact: The page says Google found that over half of mobile phone users will leave a webpage that does not load within three seconds.
facts.quote: Google learned that over half of people using their mobile phones will leave a webpage if it doesn't load within three seconds.

facts.fact: The page states that over half of all global web traffic comes from mobile devices.
facts.quote: over half of all the web traffic globally comes from mobile devices.

facts.fact: The article was published on 19 February 2024.
